base_registry.note: This source authority is stacked on the live DATA-287 registry head and does not itself rewrite the converged registry.

dedup_gate.family_accounting: Three books remain one Project Gutenberg family.

evaluation_reservation_gate.claim: No universal semantic decontamination claim. Exact training-source exclusion is enforced here; downstream DATA-299-style content-hash decontamination remains mandatory.

explicit_non_rules: No regex deletion of arbitrary boilerplate inside the body.
No spell correction, dehyphenation, modernization, OCR repair, HTML parsing, or semantic cleanup.
rules: Decode using the source-specific encoding declared below.
Canonicalize CRLF and CR to LF.
Require exactly one line whose stripped text starts with '*** START OF ' and contains 'PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK' and ends with '***'.
Require exactly one later line whose stripped text starts with '*** END OF ' and contains 'PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK' and ends with '***'.
Discard the start marker and every decoded character before it.
Discard the end marker and every decoded character after it.
Retain all material inside the markers, including title pages, producer credits, transcriber notes, illustrations-as-text, footnotes, and edition-specific matter.
Remove one U+FEFF only if it is the first character of the retained body.
Trim only leading and trailing blank lines; preserve all interior whitespace and line content.
Emit UTF-8 with LF line endings and exactly one final LF.

not_independent_from: other copies of the same Project Gutenberg edition
